author: opencode-worker-6
text: Worker-6 diagnosis round 2 (released at timebox — instrumentation fully reverted, tree clean). DECISIVE FINDING: the root's post-DIS DIO is admitted (multicast+Rule-255 gate passes) and then rejected by the commit revalidation — DodagScopeMismatch (dodag.rs commit_admitted_dio -> unwrap_or(Rejected), instrumented as arm 11). The probe values prove the state performing admit/commit is NOT the provisioned leaf DODAG: sealed.dodag_id[0] == 0x00 and current.dodag_id[0] == 0x00, while the provisioned leaf scope must carry the root_addr (0x02-prefixed Yggdrasil address). I.e., after join, the RplStack receive path (receive.rs:489 self.rpl.router.process_authenticated_dio) processes DIOs against a DEFAULT/unprovisioned DodagState instance, while the join-time DIO#1 was processed against the provisioned one (hence DIO#1 succeeded and is_joined passed). FIX DIRECTION: state-wiring in the recent RplStack refactor (provisioning.rs / mod.rs root_seqs move) — ensure the router/receive path uses the same provisioned DodagState that provisioning_leaf seeded; verify which DodagState instance router.rs:343 process_authenticated_dio delegates to vs the one RplStack::provision_leaf configures. The join path evidently reaches the provisioned state (first DIO OK) — find the divergence between the bootstrap and post-join receive paths.
